description: Change provider state through a full-provider or owner-equivalent grant on a registered provider API surface. Aurocrypt pins or validates the destination origin, binds GitHub/Supabase requests to resources authorized by this user, injects that user's OAuth credential server-side, classifies risk, and enforces the owner's financial/security/destructive/communication switches. For google.api.generic, supply the exact HTTPS Google API origin under *.googleapis.com.

account_id.description: Identifier of the connected provider account, from vault_services or vault_autonomy.

headers.description: Extra request headers as name/value pairs. Authentication is controlled by Aurocrypt and cannot be set here.

intent_lease_id.description: Optional active task-scoped Intent Lease. When supplied, it further narrows this provider action and consumes one lease action.

method.description: HTTP method for the provider request.

origin.description: Required only for dynamic surfaces such as google.api.generic. Use an origin only (for example https://run.googleapis.com), never a path, query, credentials, or fragment.

path.description: Provider-relative path only; absolute and scheme-relative URLs are rejected.

risk_hint.description: Optional descriptive hint; it cannot lower server-classified risk.

surface_id.description: Identifier of the registered provider API surface, from vault_autonomy.

name: vault_provider_write
title: Act through a fully authorized provider
